facility.name: Carousel Learning Center
facility.programs_provided: After School Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips,Night Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Non_Exact match: 514 N COLLEGE ST, KILLEEN, TX, 76541

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space: During the inspection there was not enough space to walk through the nap mats in the toddler classroom. This was corrected at the inspection when the caregiver separated the nap mats to allow a proper walk space.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space (26 TAC §746.2909(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During the inspection the floor in the after school room was observed with a crack. The ceiling panels in the preschool room were missing pieces, and insects were observed crawling on the floor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation has not had a health inspection since December of 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: During the DFPS investigation, it was found that a caregiver used inappropriate discipline by plucking a child on the hand, by hitting a child in the back of the head with an open hand, swinging a stick towards a child in care in a threatening manner, and raising their voice towards a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: A child was observed asleep in a restrictive device. This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver removed the child and placed the child in a crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A child with allergies to ants did not have an emergency allergy plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: There were wall areas in the after school classroom that need to be refurbished with paint, and spaces of floor tiles that needs replacing. All chemicals must be keep out of the reach of child to prevent accidental exposure.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The annual fire inspection had not been conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Caregivers had not completed the annual training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912): New caregivers did not have completed form 2912.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.1105(4))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: Caregivers were observed using personal cell phone devices, while caring for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: During the inspection it was found that the 3 staff who transport children in care all had expired transportation training, Their training expired 01/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: During the inspection it was found that the operation did not have a electronic child safety alarm on their 15 passenger transportation van.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2023 data from January 18, 2024, revealed the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2023 by January 15, 2023, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: During the monitoring inspection it was observed that the toddler room had a trash can, without a fully closing lid, that was storing soiled/wet diapers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's personnel policies: During the monitoring inspection two staff files were reviewed and neither employee had signed operational or personnel policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's personnel policies (26 TAC §746.901(6)(B))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: During the monitoring inspeciton it was observed that there was standing water, about 2 inches, on the playground's sandbox cover, from the rain the night before.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: During the monitoring inspection it was observed that caregivers were changing diapers and not having the children wash their hands afterwards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During the monitoring inspection it was observed that 3 of the crib sheets appeared to have not been washed recently, with dried drool and spit up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: During the follow-up inspection the bathroom used by the school age children had dirt, dried urine, and other evidence that made it appear as if it had not been cleaned recently. This was recited but corrected at inspection when the bathroom was cleaned while Child Care Regulation was present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: During the monitoring inspection it was observed that the children were arriving at the operation and being served breakfast without washing their hands first.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Minimum Standards: During the inspection it was observed that the caregivers were not familiar with the minimum standards and were not following them due to a lack of understanding of what is required by state.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Minimum Standards (26 TAC §746.1203(1))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: During the monitoring inspection the bathroom used by the school age children had dirt, paint, and other evidence that made it appear as if it had not been cleaned recently.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: During the monitoring inspection children's records were reviewed and it was found that all 10 files reviewed were missing required admission information such as medical authorization, health statements, updated immunizations, emergency contacts, and acknowledge of receipt of required documentation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: While reviewing staff files at the monitoring inspection one of the files reviewed did not have current CPR/First Aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans: During the monitoring inspection it was observed that the operation did not have an emergency plan for the children with diagnosed food allergies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans (26 TAC §746.403(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: During the monitoring inspection it was observed that a 8 month old infant was dropped off in a stroller and left sleeping in the stroller until I asked the caregiver to move the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During the inspection it was observed that there was an individual present at the operation with direct access to the children before the operation had received notification from the CBCU that the subject of a background check was eligible to be present. Caregiver left operation while Child Care Regulation was present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily: During the monitoring inspection it was observed that the operation had screen time for greater than 1 hour.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: During the monitoring inspection it was found that the operation was not completeing the daily grounds checklist each morning.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Arriving at the Facility: During the monitoring inspection it was observed that the staff were arriving at the operation and not washing their hands upon arrival.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Arriving at the Facility (26 TAC §746.3415(3))

occurrences.finding: Janitorial duties: It was found a caregiver was engaged in cleaning the classroom when they were responsible for a group of children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Janitorial duties (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(C))

occurrences.finding: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance: During the DFPS investigation it was found operation staff were placing children in time out for longer than one minute per their age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §746.2803(4))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: It was found the operation failed to notify parents of an incident that occurred when their child was in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2022, data from January 26,   2023, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2022, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: A caregiver was observed on her cell phone during naptime.     This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver put the phone away.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities (26 TAC §746.1203(6))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area - Not Used as a Passageway: The young infant room is used as a passageway to the school age room and also the toddler room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area - Not Used as a Passageway (26 TAC §746.2403(6))

occurrences.finding: Documentation  pediatric CPR-1st aid includes participant's name, training date, training title, trainer's name, length of training: The operation did not have proof of CPR/First Aid training for a caregiver.  The caregiver is current and will provide the proof to the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation  pediatric CPR-1st aid includes participant's name, training date, training title, trainer's name, length of training (26 TAC §746.1329(c)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training: 2 of 4 personnel files reviewed did not have proof of allergy or hazardous materials training.  1 of 4 personnel files reviewed did not have proof of SIDS/Shaken Baby training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: There were two instances when classrooms were out of ratio.  One caregiver was left alone with 37 school age children ages 6 to 12.  On caregiver was left alone with 7 infants ages 6 to 12 months while the caregiver walked to other areas of the building.  A second caregiver was added to the school age room and the infant teacher returned to the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans: 5 of 5 classroom did not have a current activity plan with two classrooms having a plan posted from October 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans (26 TAC §746.2203(a))
